title: The Maximum Out-of-Pocket a Restated Ridgecrest Advantage Claim Line Is Capped Against
content:
Which maximum out-of-pocket a restated claim line on a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan is capped against follows the network standing of the line and whether the plan held pays for covered out-of-network care at all.

**Clause 1.** Where the line the correction restates is an out-of-network line and the plan held pays for covered out-of-network care, the maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against is the combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket of the plan held.

**Clause 2.** Where the line the correction restates is an out-of-network line and the plan held pays nothing for covered out-of-network care — that is, a plan whose coinsurance for covered out-of-network care stands at 100 per cent of the plan allowed amount — the maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against is nothing.

**Clause 3.** Where the line the correction restates is an in-network line, the maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against is the in-network maximum out-of-pocket of the plan held.

The network standing of the line is the first thing that settles which clause governs. An in-network line goes to Clause 3 whatever the plan held pays out of network; an out-of-network line is then divided between Clauses 1 and 2 by whether the plan held pays anything for covered out-of-network care.

*A line given in network.* Clause 3 governs, and the cap is the in-network maximum out-of-pocket of the plan held.

*A line given out of network under a plan whose coinsurance for covered out-of-network care stands below 100 per cent.* Clause 1 governs, and the cap is the combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket of the plan held.

*A line given out of network under a plan whose coinsurance for covered out-of-network care stands at 100 per cent.* Clause 2 governs, and the maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against is nothing.
